programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. - - The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. - - Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. - - Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. - - The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.desc: Foghorn's annoying college buddy, Rhode Island Red, comes for a visit and then won't leave. What's worse, he muscles in on Foggy's harem and reverses most of Foggy's traps and tricks. A football session with an exploding casaba melon backfires when Red returns the pass; the exploding golf balls only explode when Foghorn hits them, and the fist in the camera only pops out when Foggy examines it to figure out what went wrong. But Foghorn finally gets the last laugh with a phony telegram about an inheritance and an exploding bowling ball as a parting gift.

programme.desc: Food connects people! A feast for the eyes that spotlights the cuisines of China in a way that’s bound to set the mouths of the whole globe watering!

programme.title: Youthful China
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick!

programme.title: Pixel Collage
programme.desc: A well-crafted collage of selected short documentaries telling stories about all aspects of China! People, technology, culture, and wildlife, all are showcased in Internet-friendly form.

programme.title: Today’s Top Pick
programme.desc: Documentaries in this slot are rebroadcasts of our most-viewed and most popular stories of the season. They feature important social, economic, environmental or other policy-driven issues, affecting lives nationwide or simply in one small village. A broad selection of top productions by Chinese top documentary producers.

programme.title: Humanities and Geography
programme.desc: A strand devoted to the nature and wildlife of China, the people who lived alongside them, and the great and diverse landscapes with which they all contend.

programme.title: Living China
programme.desc: Real life stories told from the personal perspective. Moving, dramatic, sorrows and joys, expressed emphatically and expressed quietly. Watch closely to see and understand the real China as it is lived.

programme.title: Jobs 2.0: Who's teaching the robots to work?
programme.desc: As robots gradually move from research labs into real-world tasks, a key question emerges: how do machines learn to handle complex, delicate work? At a Beijing robotics company, engineers are hand-training robotic hands, translating human experience into digital skills that can be replicated at scale. CGTN's Yang Xinmeng explores this emerging profession, speaking with the people who teach machines to cook, care, and manipulate objects with precision. Their work offers a rare glimpse into the intersection of human ingenuity and artificial intelligence – and into the ways humans and robots may collaborate in everyday life.

programme.title: World Sleep Day special: China's sleep economy 'awakening' new consumer trends
programme.desc: This episode of BizTalk explores China's fast-growing sleep economy – from smart mattresses and sleep aids to tracking technology and health management, the demand for better sleep is on the rise. CGTN's Lincoln Humphries speaks with Aleksey Efremov, senior vice president of IKEA China; Wang Jin, leader of McKinsey's Life Sciences & Healthcare Practice in China; and David Yuen, managing director of TEMPUR China, on what’s driving this trend.

programme.title: Jingdezhen Handmade Porcelain
programme.desc: Porcelain has shaped the culture of the whole world. The wisdom behind each of 72 procedures has been refined from generation to generation. The times may change, some techniques may change, but what remains the same is the burning flame of the kiln that keeps setting so many hearts on fire for this ancient craft.

programme.title: The Elegance of Luoyang
programme.desc: Luoyang, as the eastern starting point of the Silk Road, is a city with a rich history and a tradition of cultural inclusivity. As such, it enjoys a prominent position in the heritage of the whole world. In this episode, we’ll visit White Horse Temple to learn about its fascinating international background. At Longmen Grottoes, which were designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in the year 2000, we’ll appreciate how the unique ancient splendor is being revived by 3D technology. At the city’s annual Peony Festival, we’ll explore the significance of China’s national flower and national dress. Invited to a Luoyang Water Banquet, we’ll learn something about the city’s culinary traditions. And finally, a master of tang sancai, or tri-color pottery, will discuss the legacy of this ancient craft and its place in the modern era.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen
programme.desc: Join our hosts Tianran He and Eva May as they explore the boisterous event of Wuzhen's International Theatre festival, with colorful features of both theatrical and culinary nature. Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. Let's set the stage for the beautiful merge of food and drama as they taste their way through the charming scene of Wuzhen.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.5
programme.desc: Guangdong, sheltered by the Nanling Mountains, is a province where rivers cascade from hills on their way to the ocean. But before they meet the sea, they pass through another land of plenty, a place where solid earth encounters the rolling waves in a truly loving embrace - the Pearl River Delta.

programme.title: Back to the Land: Exploring new life in rural China
programme.desc: When we think of the countryside, what colour comes to mind? The answer lies in Wuxin—Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water—an ancient rhythm that still pulses beneath China’s landscapes. In this programme, we explore how the colours of Wuxing come to life through the traditions of China’s ethnic minority groups. From Lugu Lake’s matrilineal water world and the metal-hued fire of the Yi Torch Festival, to Dali’s earth-driven crafts, Guizhou’s wooden Dong dwellings, and the volcanic winds of Inner Mongolia’s new nomadic life—the Five Elements guide the stories of people reconnecting with land, culture and community.

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.” The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests at sunset, reflecting on the deep-rooted role Nanyin plays in the daily lives of Quanzhou’s people.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition. From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.6
programme.desc: The mountainous realm of Fujian's centers around the Wuyi range, just opposite Taiwan Province. Join us as we trace a heritage of tea production in ancient villages, marvel at waterside Danxia, and discover terraces where seas of lotuses grow...

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. From honest farm-to-table fare, to the culinary heights of French haute cuisine, and even a cooking class and wine and dine event at a traditional courtyard home in the city center, we'll discover that in Beijing, you can taste the world.

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition. From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.6
programme.desc: The mountainous realm of Fujian's centers around the Wuyi range, just opposite Taiwan Province. Join us as we trace a heritage of tea production in ancient villages, marvel at waterside Danxia, and discover terraces where seas of lotuses grow...

programme.title: Culture Forward
programme.desc: Culture Forward is set at a pivotal moment between the close of China’s 14th Five-Year Plan and the launch of the 15th. The program explores how technology is giving culture new momentum, featuring cases such as Guizhou’s mechanized batik techniques, the digital presentation of Liangzhu culture, AI-powered design for Miao embroidery, and creative innovation at the Hunan Museum. Through real-world practices, it reveals how traditional Chinese culture is being revitalized in the age of intelligence—moving toward a future that is more open, innovative, and high-quality.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: The Korean Dish Expedition - The Korean Dish Expedition Ep.14

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky (2024)
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Tour de la Provence 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Since its creation in 2016, the CIC Tour de La Provence has established itself as a key stage on the cycling calendar, offering top riders ideal training grounds for the Tour de France. Between demanding climbs and iconic landscapes, the race tests punchers, climbers, and sprinters, attracting a high-level field each year. More than just a competition, it embodies the popular spirit of cycling and benefits from the support of a passionate region, making each edition an unmissable event of the season.

programme.title: Mediterranean Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Epic offers an UCI 4 stage race where mountain bikers enjoy mountain biking to the fullest during the route around Oropesa del Mar, in the Castellón province in Spain. From 05th to 08th of February 2026 the race leads through spectacular Mediterranean mild weather and routes with a perfect combination of sea and mountain!

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025

Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

Battling the cold and unpredictable waters of the English Channel, Gerrard faces not only the rough conditions but also the need to swim in synchronization with his team of guide swimmers, Hayden, Phil, Jo, Rosie, Alexis, and Sarah by his side.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata in the Julian Alps Eng
programme.desc: Just about an hours drive from Ljubljana airport, Prisojnik, or Prisank as its also called is a beautiful 2,547m mountain in Slovenias Julian Alps.This one-day via Ferrata route is a must-do since it presents an excellent hiking and climbing challenge, but also offers all of the views youd even want. To get to its summit Cris and Viv hiked, scrambled, climbed, and even crawled on their stomachs at points, but the views in the end and the feeling of satisfaction that came after made it all worthwhile.

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Aussie 8
programme.desc: Aussie 8 is the adventure of 3 friends who decided to climb the 8 tallest mountains in 8 Australian states in 8 days. To make this possible, they had to put together and respect a very strict timing and logistic organisation.

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Challenge Family 2025 - Season Wrap Up Eng
programme.desc: Since its founding, the Challenge Family triathlon series has redefined the spirit of endurance sports. Known for its unique courses, passionate community, and athlete-centered values, Challenge Family offers races in some of the world’s most iconic locations. From the breathtaking landscapes to the demands of each event, Challenge Family is about more than just competition. It’s about athletes pushing beyond their limits, fueled by the support of fans, family, and each other. Through the journeys of athletes, everyone can understand what it takes to prepare, to overcome, and to race with a purpose that goes far beyond the finish line.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: Florence Marathon - We run in art Eng
programme.desc: two select runners comment on their participation in the Florence marathon and the organizers provide unique insights on the Florence marathon.

programme.title: The High
programme.desc: THE HIGH is a feature length documentary film about the making of the longest high altitude foot race in the world. The film follows the path of a group of extreme runners who individually decide to take part of a dangerous running experiment gone wrong. Indian race director Rajat Chauhan works against the advice of the military, his family and friends to create a race over the two highest passes in the world (above 17 500ft). The decline begins from the start, with runners collapsing from dehydration, hypothermia, and high-altitude sickness. And by its end finds the entire race in jeopardy and the prospect that no one finishes. Brought to life by archive footage, story recreations, and interviews, the film unfolds the events in the Himalayas of Northern India and gives a unique look into the lives of the extreme marathon runners involved. Uncovering the avalanches, athletes, and the high altitude elements. THE HIGH shows the rewards of determination, the dangers of obsession, and in the end leaves you with the answer of why they called it, the toughest race on earth. Directed by Barry Walton.

programme.title: Norcha Eng
programme.desc: Norcha is more than a race — it’s a journey into the heart of human endurance. Set against the breathtaking landscapes of northern Portugal, Norcha follows teams of adventurers as they leave their comfort zones and confront a challenge designed to push the very limits of body and mind. Trekking, kayaking, mountain biking, rappelling — every stage forces competitors to adapt, to endure, and to discover new depths of resilience. But Norcha is not just about competition. It is about connection — with teammates, with nature, and with the spirit of exploration itself. Guided by values of solidarity, humility, and dedication, this odyssey reveals that the greatest victories are not only measured at the finish line, but in the moments of transformation along the way.

programme.title: Ultra Gobi 2025 Eng
programme.desc: Each year, athletes from across the world gather in this remote wilderness og the Gobi desert for a test like no other. The 121-kilometer team challenge is where cooperation and strategy are everything, while the 121-kilometere solo adventure is a test for the braves. The legendary 400-kilometer race, a journey through solitude, extremes, and self-discovery. All together, they form one of the toughest endurance events on Earth.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: UK Challenge 2025
programme.desc: Talent can win you the game, but its intelligence and teamwork that will win you the championship once, said the NBA basketball legend. That is Michael Jordan and hes right. And in this case, its the seven individual stages that are the games and the overall championship is the 2025 UK challenge. For the next three days and nights, nearly 70 teams will be putting themselves through what is the most mentally and physically demanding team building competition that youll see anywhere, and theyre all doing it for the challenge of building teamwork and the acclaim of picking up that overall Winners Trophy.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.desc: Josh spent 4 months self filming his bike trip home from the Giant bike factory in Shanghai. During his 15 000 km trip between Shanghai China and Newcastle UK, he crossed 19 countries. A fantastic human adventure and a unique bike trip !

programme.title: Mongolia Horseback Archery World Championships 2023
programme.desc: For 2023, Mongolia and its capital Ulaanbaatar was brought in the spotlight of official horseback archery competition, that has grown a lot over the last few years in many places around the world. Everything started with the Spirit International HBA tournament in the beginning of September and this event would set the stage for the pinnacle one that was about to follow: the 2023 International Horse Archery Alliance World Championships.

programme.desc: Our bikepacker friend Michele is exploring the Japanese island of Hokkaido. On the agenda: volcanoes, forests, wilderness, brown bears, fishing owls, the Pacific Ocean, and weather that isnt always kind. Episode 3.

programme.title: 12th Longines Equestrian Beijing Masters 2025
programme.desc: China. Beijing. A city where history breathes through every stone and shimmer of steel. Here, where dynasties once rode across vast plains, a new kind of cavalry takes the stage riders of precision, courage, and grace. Each autumn, the National Stadium, the Bird’s Nest transforms. Where Olympic legends once soared, hooves now thunder. This is the Longines Beijing Masters — the heart of Asian equestrian sport, and a meeting place for the world’s finest.

programme.desc: We will start this episode with the Standard Chartered Singapore Marathon 2025 with over 55,000 runners from around 80 countries. We are then travelling to Spain for the Font Vella Lanzarote International Marathon. From Spain, we are catching a flight to neighboring Portugal to attend the end of the 2025 season of the TRITON World Series. Next we follow the 6th edition of HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB. Then we move to Geneva for another edition of CHI Geneva, Rolex Grand Prix. Finally we move to Saudi Arabia for the 2025 FIBA Asia Cup.

programme.title: International Temiscamingue Raid Eng
programme.desc: The International Temiscamingue Raid is the first stage event to be part of the Adventure Race World Series, an international series that specializes in adventure races and which brings together the best endurance athletes in the world. Last September, athletes from Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Finland and Canada and seven local teams from Temiscamingue participated in the Raid Témiscamingue.

programme.title: Tour of Oman and Muscat Classic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The 2026 Tour of Oman is a road cycling stage race rated as a category 2 Pro event on the 2026 UCI ProSeries calendar, and is the 15th edition of the Tour of Oman. 18 teams are participating with top athletes such as Adam Yates. The Muscat Classic is a cycling race which takes place as a prelude to the Tour Of Oman on a difficult 174 kilometer route between Al Mouj Muscat and Al Bustan with 6 climbs totaling 2,000 meters of D+.

programme.title: Tour de la Provence 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Since its creation in 2016, the CIC Tour de La Provence has established itself as a key stage on the cycling calendar, offering top riders ideal training grounds for the Tour de France. Between demanding climbs and iconic landscapes, the race tests punchers, climbers, and sprinters, attracting a high-level field each year. More than just a competition, it embodies the popular spirit of cycling and benefits from the support of a passionate region, making each edition an unmissable event of the season.

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Men 2026
programme.desc: Australia’s greatest cycling race is back to launch the international cycling season. South Australia is celebrated at its best, taking the peloton across 6 stages. The 2026 Santos Tour Down Under mens race features a tough climb - Knotts Hill. Each stage pays homage to the events history while exploring great landscapes, promising thrilling challenges for the riders.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: Taíba, Brazil, host the final stop of the GKA Kite World Tour 2025. The world’s top riders will take to Taíba’s powerful Atlantic waves for four days of action-packed competition that will determine the men’s and women’s world titles. The event marks the thrilling conclusion to a season that has already visited Cape Verde, Dakhla, and Sylt.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: Oman Downwinder Eng
programme.desc: The Oman Downwinder movie intents to show Oman and its conditions for wind powered sports. It is a movie that explores behaviours, the Omani hospitality, the landscape and attractions of Oman within the downwinder route and not, exclusively, a movie about kitesufing/Wingfoiling. The movie was designed to explore the experience of professional kiteboarders/wingfoilers (Ambassadors) interacting with amateur riders based in Oman on this 7-day trip along the coast. Apart from the Ambassadors, the movie also explores the Oman Kitesurfing community via local actors and their experiences during the downwinder.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: GKA Kite-Surf World Cup Cape Verde 2026
programme.desc: The 2026 GKA Kite-Surf season once again opens in the iconic point break of Cape Verde’s Sal Island, with the title race set to be tighter than ever as it plays out over a scheduled five globe-trotting stops. A full line-up of 24 men and an expanding roster of women, with 18 athletes, from a total of 13 countries around the world are set to battle for glory in the intimidating right-hander of Ponta Preta that.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: All The Way Eng
programme.desc: From award-winning documentary filmmaker Carl Eneroth at Sthlm Social Innovation Lab comes "All the Way". A heart-pounding, intimate and mind expanding portrait of Swimrun team Pontus Lindberg and George Bjälkemo, as they prepare for their ultimate challenge… winning the 75 km ÖtillÖ Swimrun World Championships in the Stockholm archipelago… in trail shoes and a wetsuit.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taiba - Brazil 2025
programme.desc: The second and final call of the GKA Freestyle season is set to play out in the sumptuous conditions of Brazil’s Taíba lagoon, where the 2025 world champions will be crowned. The world championship titles are in the balance after the opening stop in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates, several weeks ago, ended inconclusively when the wind declined to play ball for the freestylers. That effectively makes the GKA Freestyle Kite World Cup Taíba 2025 a one-stop world championship for the 2025 titles, leaving no margin for slip-ups from leading contenders, who are all in Brazil.

programme.title: Inside Sailing 2026 - Episode 1
programme.desc: In our previous episode, we visited various countries starting from Brazil. The 2025 Wingfoil Racing World Cup roared back to life on Brazil’s north-east coast, launching its season finale. In this episode, sailors from around the world have gathered for the inaugural World Sailing Inclusion Championships, racing in one of the most stunning coastal destinations on the planet: Oman. We have a full season of sailing action ahead of us, but 2025 was also filled with spectacle from around the world. With kiteboarding now inducted to the Olympic Games since Paris 2024, watching the latest developments in the class was a ‘must’ for Inside Sailing.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: The Rise of the Hamminator Lindsey Hamm s journey from concrete to peaks
programme.desc: Mammut athlete Lindsey Hamm, a professional climber and mountain guide, brings a breath of fresh air to the world of mountaineering. Originally from Texas, she has begun making a name for herself in recent years. This short film offers a glimpse into her life, a recent expedition to Pakistan’s wild Charakusa Valley. Beyond the mountains, Lindsey is a people person, driven by a passion for inclusivity in climbing, and giving opportunities to other women, who want to get into the sport. She collaborates with womens organizations in Pakistan, helping to dismantle barriers and create opportunities for education and growth.

programme.title: Nine Mountains
programme.desc: The journey of two cyclists (Leo Russell & George Stagg) on a mission to climb the 9 most challenging and notorious mountains in Europe. From Austria To Spain, Nine Mountains is an adventure of brutality and beauty exploring the limits of the mind and body. The boys cycled over 3,200km from blistering snowstorms to scorching deserts whilst ascending the equivalent of eight times the height of Everest. The film follows a never been done route with the aim to raise £100,000 towards mens mental health charity James Place, an organisation set up to help men in suicidal crisis.

programme.title: Climbing Skye s Highest Peak - Sgurr Alasdair
programme.desc: Cris and Viv decided to climb Sgurr Alasdair, the highest mountain on the island of Skye, located in an area of the mountain range known as Black Cullin. The main challenge they had in climbing the peak was the Great Stone Chute. A 300-meter slope of the harshest mountain terrain - scree. The summit of Sgurr Alasdair has unobstructed views of all of the Munroes in the Black Cullin, and also of one of Skyes most famous routes - The Cullin Ridge traverse.

programme.title: World Rookie Freeski Finals 2025
programme.desc: The World Rookie Tour is excited that the Freeski Finals are held in the magnificent Ursus Snowpark at Madonna di Campiglio. This event shows the world’s most talented young freeski athletes as they compete in one of the most celebrated snowparks in Europe. This exclusive opportunity brings the excitement and competitive spirit of one of the most anticipated events in youth action sports directly to athletes, fans and viewers.

programme.title: Summiting Mt Sneffels in Colorado Eng
programme.desc: Mount Sneffels is a prominent mountain near Ouray, Colorado in the United States which is over 14,000 feet high, more than 4,300 metres. Audree had never climbed a 14er, so we decided to try reach its summit while on a road trip through Colorado in late-July.

programme.title: A Feather in the West
programme.desc: In September 2019, a team of talented Irish climbers [Chloe Condron, Kevin Kilroy, Michelle OLoughlin and Conor McGovern] travelled to the small island of Owey to explore sea cliffs that local guidebook writer Iain Miller claims, have “enough new routing potential to last at least twelve lifetimes”. ‘A Feather in the West’ is a film about their trad climbing experiences and the relatively niche pursuit of first ascents, set on the Wild Atlantic Way, off the west coast of County Donegal. (Special thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Margalef - Climbing
programme.desc: Margalef is a little village next to the Monsant river, in Catalunya. The most amazing rocks in Europe and hundreds routes for climbing. Pure fun and climbing in this little entertaining film.

programme.title: Skiing China Exploring Altai Mountains
programme.desc: A quartet of champion skiers and snowboarders from Australia and the USA visit the unexplored Altai Frontier in China, now believed to be the place where skiing first developed, more than 10,000 years ago. They encounter the ancient culture of the region and explore the spectacular local slopes, using their own hi-tech equipment as well as the traditional skis manufactured by local craftsmen using age-old practices. The four visitors, Scott Kneller, Jari Hiatt, Halina Boyd and Harry Kearney, all of whom have world-beating careers in snowboarding, skiing and ski mountaineering, discover new challenges and new frontiers in China’s remote north-western province.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Expedition Antarctica of extreme sports woman Caro North
programme.desc: Iceclimbing, ski mountaineering and sailing the open water for days through the infamous Drake Passage: The 28 years old extreme sports woman Caro North made her way to the very South of our continent for a four weeks expedition – accompanied by an eight-member crew. Antarctica turned out to be a paradise for extreme sports: deserted landscapes and snow-capped mountains against a surreal backdrop of ice and sea were waiting to be discovered.

programme.title: Dark Peak Fell Runners
programme.desc: The Dark Peak Fell Runners base themselves in Sheffield, but their playground is the Peak District National Park where they weave tracks through the fields, peat bogs and rocky outcrops to create a tapestry of eccentricity, endeavour and endurance. As one of the biggest pure fell running clubs in the UK, the ‘Dark Peak Fell Runners’ captures the personality, quirks and successes of the club and its members. Shot throughout the course of a year, the film follows in their footsteps to reveal their well-trodden Peak District running routes including the club’s flagship race, the Edale Skyline. (Special Thanks to Pertex)

programme.title: Alone And Without A Guide On Mexico s Third Highest Mountain-Iztaccihuatl Eng
programme.desc: Being alone and without a guide in a summit attempt for the third highest mountain in Mexico was a dream. The climb is amazing. The ridge to Iztaccihuatls summit feels endless, but the views of the surrounding valleys and Popocatepetl make the effort worth it.

programme.title: Best Via Ferrata In The Dolomites Climbing Possnecker Eng
programme.desc: Cris and Viv climb Piz Selva, a 2,941m mountain belonging to the Sella group, an iconic giant of the Dolomites.They start their hike from Passo Sella, and their chosen route was via Ferrata Possnecker (also called Ferrata delle Mesules), one of the oldest Via Ferratas in the Dolomites.

programme.title: Grand Teton Loop Eng
programme.desc: Grand Teton National Park is a stunning and iconic park in the US, known for its majestic Teton Range, beautiful lakes, and diverse wildlife. In July of 2022, Jeff and Audrée made a stop on their way back to Canada while on a road trip to Colorado, so that they could run a 38 mile / 62 km loop around the park, which mile for mile would be one of the most scenic and beautiful routes theyve ever run.

programme.title: Nendaz Backcountry Invitational 2026
programme.desc: Nestled in the heart of the Swiss Alps, the Nendaz Backcountry Invitational by The North Face 2026 is one of the most exciting events on the freeride calendar. This unique competition brings together some of the world’s top backcountry athletes, showcasing their incredible skills and creativity in untouched snow.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: UTMB KODIAK Ultra Marathon 2025
programme.desc: Two distances. One adventure. Feel the grit of the 50K, the madness of the 100K, and the shared passion that drives every runner forward. Dive into 45 minutes of raw trail energy. Relive the HOKA Kodiak Ultramarathons as if you were there.

programme.title: Ungrounded Episode 3 - Meredith Edwards
programme.desc: Meredith Edwards is an elite-level mountain ultra runner, with podium finishes at the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc TDS race, the Javelina Jundred 100K and the Flagstaff Skyrace 55K. She is also a member of the U.S. Ski Mountaineering Team. In Episode 3, she reveals how in 2019 she fought an inner struggle with her body that almost resulted in a full blood transfusion-and came back from it to win one of the world’s most challenging Ultra Marathons. (English version with French, German, Italian and Spanish subtitles available)

programme.title: X-out Montenegro Eng
programme.desc: X-out Montenegro is part of the Xtri World Tour. Athletes starts with a 1.7 km open-water course. The race is started by the Xekutioner, a formidable figure who will be responsible for future eliminations. 15 of athletes will be eliminated by the Xekutioner, intensifying the competition. Eliminated athletes are given a time penatly and can then try to catch “The Splitter” to ovetake backmarkers and get back in the race! Then a tough and demanding 40 km asphalt cycle which climbs the famous serpentine above Kotor. Designed to test endurance to the max. Another 15 of athletes are eliminated by the Xekutioner here, ensuring only the toughest stay. Finally 6.5 km of downhill trail running and 2.5 km of “vertical” monster climbing. Again eliminated athletes have the opportunity to catch the leaders.

programme.title: Trans Sahara Marathon 2025
programme.desc: The Trans Sahara Marathon. Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sahara Desert, this epic race, held in February 2025, challenges runners to traverse 150 kilometers across four grueling stages of unforgiving terrain. Drawing the worlds top athletes from every corner of the globe, the Trans Sahara Marathon is more than just a race; its a testament to the boundless limits of human potential and the relentless pursuit of greatness.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Muay Thai, rivierfestivals, toeristenscams en olifantenmenners! Dit is Thailand, bekeken op de Road Less Traveled-manier.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan verkent de uiterste randen van Indonesië: zwarte magiërs, semi-actieve vulkanen en zwavelspuwende meren!

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1
programme.desc: Leon ontvangt een eervolle zegen op zijn reis. In Efeze treedt Leon in de voetsporen van apostel Paulus, voordat de escalatie van een conflict in het Midden-Oosten zijn reis in gevaar brengen.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness One® bezoeken 's werelds beroemdste monument van de liefde, de Taj Mahal, voordat hun reis op een muur stuit - letterlijk. Na een dag hard werken op een Indiase boerderij reist Leon naar de Stad van Vuur.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S1
programme.sub-title: Ireland - Dublin, what else is there besides the pub culture
programme.desc: Geef toe, het eerste waar je aan denkt bij Dublin zijn de pubs. Natuurlijk, ze zijn niet weg te denken en ze serveren enkele van de beste bieren ter wereld. En ze hebben een bijbehorende cultuur die moeilijk te evenaren is. Maar hoe zit het met het eten? Heeft Dublin een bloeiende foodiescene of draait het alleen maar om een pint Guinness? Ontdek het in deze aflevering van Max Foodie, waarin Liesel het adembenemend mooie Ierland verkent.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: De Filippijnen zijn een ongelooflijke bestemming met talloze herinneringen aan de Tweede Wereldoorlog, historische connecties die teruggaan tot Magellan en een gelukkige, vriendelijke bevolking.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Er is waarschijnlijk geen plek op aarde die zo rijk is aan wilde dieren als de Pantanal in Brazilië. In deze Quest gaat Bill enkele van de regenwoudwezens opsporen die hij altijd al heeft willen zien.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Men zegt dat de tijd alle wonden heelt, maar kan zij ook de meest afschuwelijke helen – genocide? In deze Quest keert Bill terug naar Rwanda om te zien hoe dit kleine, maar wereldwijd betekenisvolle land na de oorlog genezing en verzoening vindt.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trekt naar het Peak District in Engeland om de 430 kilometer lange Pennine Way – de oudste en meest uitdagende langeafstandswandelroute van Groot-Brittannië – aan te pakken.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2
programme.desc: Eric Hanson trekt diep het achterland in om de bergen, gletsjers en wilde dieren rond Alaska’s hoofdstad Juneau te verkennen.

programme.title: Epic Trails S2
programme.desc: Eric Hanson reist naar Jämtland, Zweden, op 63 graden noorderbreedte, waar hij een pure wilderniscultuur en adembenemende natuurpaden ontdekt.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan laat zien waarom zijn thuisstaat de ultieme bestemming is voor buitenactiviteiten: trackdays, paragliden en zwemmen. De reis begint in San Francisco en slingert helemaal naar het zuiden, tot aan Los Angeles.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Terug in Azië begint Jonathan aan een wandeltocht om alle verborgen kanten van Manila te ontdekken – een tocht die eindigt met een ontmoeting met niemand minder dan Manny Pacquiao!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S2
programme.desc: Jonathan speurt naar gevallen van mystiek en lokale folklore. Als tegenhanger van het macabere besluit hij zijn eigen schoonheidswedstrijd te organiseren in de stad Iloilo.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1
programme.desc: Leon is mogelijk gestrand, wanneer Kindness One® in Patna stopt met werken. Later vervult hij de droom van elke Engelsman in Darjeeling, voordat hij naar Bhutan reist om het "Bruto Nationaal Geluk" in actie te zien.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1
programme.desc: Leon en Kindness One® moeten de lange route nemen om naar Thailand te reizen, maar tocht slaagt hij er in om het tot een avontuur te maken. In Cambodja vervult Leon een kinderdroom wanneer hij de oude tempel van Angkor Wat bezoekt.

programme.title: Kindness Diaries S1
programme.desc: Een bezoek aan The Killing Fields van Cambodja is een pijnlijke herinnering aan de duistere kant van de mensheid. In Ho Chi Minh City ervaart Leon de modernisering van Vietnam. Terwijl hij op zoek is naar eten, ontmoet Leon toevallig een vrouw die hem inspireert.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2
programme.desc: Grote stad, groot geld — Hongkong telt het hoogste aantal miljonairs ter wereld, en dat merk je meteen wanneer je deze metropool betreedt. In deze aflevering onderzoekt Sashi hoe Michelin de enorme diversiteit aan eetgelegenheden in de stad beoordeelt. Hij ontmoet topchefs en duikt in hun denkwijze, uitdagingen en het pad naar succes op weg naar drie Michelinsterren. Maar het blijft niet bij haute cuisine: Sashi verkent ook traditionele volkswijken, proeft lokale specialiteiten en zoekt uit hoe Michelin de volle breedte van Aziatische eetgelegenheden evalueert.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2
programme.desc: Grote stad, groot geld — Hongkong telt het hoogste aantal miljonairs ter wereld, en dat merk je meteen wanneer je deze metropool betreedt. In deze aflevering onderzoekt Sashi hoe Michelin de enorme diversiteit aan eetgelegenheden in de stad beoordeelt. Hij ontmoet topchefs en duikt in hun denkwijze, uitdagingen en het pad naar succes op weg naar drie Michelinsterren. Maar het blijft niet bij haute cuisine: Sashi verkent ook traditionele volkswijken, proeft lokale specialiteiten en zoekt uit hoe Michelin de volle breedte van Aziatische eetgelegenheden evalueert.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2
programme.desc: Het is een onmetelijke opgave om de Indiase keuken volledig te doorgronden; de rijkdom ervan is simpelweg enorm. In de komende twee afleveringen reist Sashi dwars door het land, van kust tot kust, om te ontdekken hoe de keuken verandert naarmate de kilometers oplopen. Deze aflevering begint met een ontmoeting met Mumbai’s populairste chef, Prateek Sadhu. Sashi krijgt een exclusief kijkje achter de schermen bij hoe Masque — het bekendste restaurant van de stad — hun kenmerkende “8 hands”-samenwerking organiseert. Samen met Prateek en zijn gerenommeerde gastchefs, Matt Orlando uit Kopenhagen en Ivan Brehm van Nouri in Singapore, reist het trio naar Delhi op zoek naar ingrediënten. Van biodynamische boerderijen aan de rand van de stad tot de oude markten van Delhi waar ze specerijen opsporen — Sashi onderzoekt in detail hoe deze culinaire topsamenwerkingen van begin tot eind tot stand komen.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2
programme.desc: De culinaire ontdekkingsreis door India gaat verder. Dit keer bevindt Sashi zich aan de oostelijke rand van het land, waar hij geniet van de koloniale pracht van Kolkata, de levendige vismarkten verkent en het bijzondere verhaal ontdekt van India’s enige Chinatown. Daarna reist hij zuidwaarts naar Odisha, waar hij een unieke kans krijgt: toegang tot de maha bhog van de Jagannath-tempel in Puri — een indrukwekkende dagelijkse voedseloffertraditie voor Heer Jagannath, die behoort tot een van de grootste keukens ter wereld en elke dag meer dan 100,000 mensen voedt. De recepten en ingrediënten zijn al duizenden jaren onveranderd gebleven — een scherp contrast met de vorige aflevering, waarin het moderne restaurant Masque en hun baanbrekende technieken centraal stonden — en het toont hoe ongelooflijk divers de Indiase culinaire wereld is.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2
programme.desc: Het grootste deel van safari-Afrika is bevolkt met de megafauna die we regelmatig op tv zien: leeuwen, savanneolifanten, nijlkrokodillen en kafferbuffels, om er maar een paar te noemen. Er is één gebied van het Afrikaanse regenwoud waar dat niet het geval is.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S2
programme.desc: Indonesië telt duizenden eilanden en exotische ingrediënten. Maar het bekendste eiland is zonder twijfel Bali. Bali staat bekend als een toevluchtsoord voor reizigers die op zoek zijn naar gezondheidsretraites, luxe villa's en weelderige tropische vakantie-ervaringen, en is zonder twijfel een van de meest bezochte eilandbestemmingen. Maar er is een verborgen kant aan Bali die geworteld is in cultuur, mysterie en sporen van de grootse pracht van het oude koninkrijk Bali. Om dit te helpen ontdekken, ontmoet Sashi Reynaldo De Luna, de chef-kok van het legendarische Amandari. Onder begeleiding van Rey krijgt Sashi een kijkje achter de schermen bij oude tempelceremonies en gaat hij op zoek naar cashewnoten, kruidnagel, vanille en andere exotische ingrediënten in de echte wildernis van Bali. Dit is een kijkje achter de schermen van de authentieke culinaire kant van Bali, iets wat volledig verborgen is voor de westerse wereld!
